The '''Fourth Fleet''' was part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
The Fourth [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] was noted for being destroyed by the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
